subject: Activation surge coordination — enablement packet, pricing path, and QBR asks
messages:
From: David Hill <david.hill@acmecorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T13:12:00Z
Subject: Activation kickoff + QBR prep — enablement & pricing questions

Hi Tessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Acme leadership is aligned and they want to accelerate the pilot into a wider activation starting mid-April. Two immediate asks as we head toward the QBR next month:

1) Do you have an enablement packet (slides + one-pager) we can share with our ops and support teams? We need something that covers integration touchpoints, support expectations, and a quick playbook for first-week ramp.
2) On pricing — we were quoted earlier but procurement wants a clear breakdown of committed vs burst usage and any prepayment/discount options. Can you send the current pricing grid and confirm how overage credits are handled?

Also can we get a short SL summary for our legal/compliance folks (data residency, audit logs)? If possible, can you get all of the above into one email by EOD Thursday so we can fold it into our QBR agenda?

David
Director, Cloud Integrations
Acme Corp

P.S. attaching the QBR slot we were offered (internal).

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: David Hill <david.hill@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-02T16:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Activation kickoff + QBR prep — enablement & pricing questions

Hi David —

Great to hear the timing. Looping in owners for the materials and to confirm timelines:

- Enablement packet & playbook: Marissa (enablement) to own.
- Pricing grid + committed vs burst clarifications: Ben (pricing) to own.
- SLA/Compliance summary (data residency + audit logs): Karthik (security/compliance) + Laura (legal) to confirm one-pager.
- Support ramp expectations and escalation path: Grace (support) to provide runbook excerpt.

Target: consolidated package (pptx + one-pager + pricing sheet + SLA summary) to David by 2027-03-04 EOD PT. If one team has a blocker to that timeline, flag here ASAP.

Marissa/Ben/Karthik/Laura/Grace — please reply with your committed deliverable and any outstanding dependencies by EOD today. I will compile and send to David.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Product Marketing | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: 2027-03-03T16:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Activation kickoff + QBR prep — enablement & pricing questions

Quick commit from enablement side — timeline and deliverables:

- Deliverable: enablement_packet_v1.pptx (slides + 1x one-pager) — covers integration touchpoints, day-0 checklist, first-week support runbook excerpt.
- Owner: Marissa Cole (Enablement)
- Dependencies: need final SLA snippet from Karthik; need confirmation of any custom onboarding steps from Acme (David, anything custom besides SSO and VPC peering?).
- ETA: Draft by 2027-03-04 09:00 PT, final by 2027-03-04 17:00 PT.

Action tracker (short):
- Marissa: enablement_packet_v1.pptx (draft by 03/04 09:00)
- Ben: pricing_grid_v2.xlsx (final by 03/04 12:00)
- Karthik: sla_summary_2027-03.pdf (first pass by 03/04 11:00)
- Grace: support_runbook_excerpt.txt (by 03/04 14:00)

David — if those ETA windows work for you we will consolidate and send a single zip (pptx/xlsx/pdf) to your team.

-Marissa
Sr. Manager, Enablement

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, David Hill <david.hill@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-03T23:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Activation kickoff + QBR prep — enablement & pricing questions

Committing to the pricing deliverable and a quick note on OKR alignment for the QBR.

- Pricing deliverable: pricing_grid_v2.xlsx attached to internal thread (will send consolidated file to Acme on 03/04 12:00 PT). This shows committed baseline, burst rates, prepay discount tiers, and overage credit mechanics.
- Commercial note for QBR (one-liner slide): propose we position Acme as a "priority early adopter — activation cohort A" and call out expected cost delta for committed vs burst.

OKR alignment: for the QBR slide deck we should include a one-slide status per function (GTM, Enablement, Support, Legal/Compliance, Pricing). Please keep to one slide and use the QBR template in Confluence. I will reserve a 5-minute slot for the pricing ask and a 10-minute slot for the activation plan.

HubSpot: attached HS-987654 (deal stage: Contracting).
Confluence QBR template: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/GO/Activation+QBR+template

-Ben
Head of Pricing & GTM Economics

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: David Hill <david.hill@acmecorp.com>
Date: 2027-03-04T00:45:00Z
Subject: Final: Acme activation package + QBR prep — next steps

Team — thank you for the fast turnaround. Summary and final ask:

What we will send to Acme (consolidated, 03/04 EOD PT):
- enablement_packet_v1.pptx (Marissa)
- pricing_grid_v2.xlsx (Ben)
- sla_summary_2027-03.pdf (Karthik/Laura)
- support_runbook_excerpt.txt (Grace)

QBR prep:
- Each function to produce a single slide using the Confluence template (link below). Deck due 03/05 12:00 PT so we can stitch and rehearse.
- Ben will present the pricing slide (5 mins), Marissa will present enablement/activation plan (10 mins).

OKR callouts for the slide (please include):
- GTM: target activation date (mid-April), expected active seats, and success metric (90% healthy within Week 2).
- Enablement: ramp completion % by Day 14, enablement NPS baseline.
- Support: initial SLA targets and on-call coverage during ramp.
- Legal/Compliance: any open items that would block go-live.

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-activation-pack | HubSpot: HS-987654 | Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/GO/Activation+QBR+template

David — we will send the consolidated package to your team by EOD PT and follow up with an invite for a 30-min sync next week to run the short QBR rehearsal.

Thanks again — Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Director, Product Marketing | Redwood Inference
